content: Do not be ashamed of being helped. It is your duty to achieve your work, like a soldier on the battlements.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Reminding yourself of your mortality is not morbid; it is the most clarifying lens available to human consciousness. When you remember that your days are strictly numbered, petty resentments and trivial anxieties evaporate.

Across his life and work, Marcus Aurelius saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Death gives urgency and sweetness to every ordinary afternoon. Because this day will never come again, the way you spend your attention right now is of monumental significance.
reflectionPrompt: What current difficulty or obstacle are you facing that could become your greatest training ground?
